Path('/scratch/tiny').write_text('tiny')
r={'tiny':Path('/scratch/tiny').read_text(),'uid':os.geteuid(),'label':Path('/proc/self/attr/current').read_text().strip(),'status':{k:v for k,v in (line.split(':',1) for line in Path('/proc/self/status').read_text().splitlines() if ':' in line) if k in ('CapEff','CapPrm','CapAmb','CapBnd','NoNewPrivs')},'ns':{n:os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/'+n) for n in ('user','mnt','pid','net')}}

 f=os.memfd_create('synthetic-capability',0); os.write(f,b'x'); os.close(f); r['memfd_denied']=False
